description: Rules-of-thumb valuation multiples for the exit-readiness check (src/readiness/multiples.ts). low / mid / high are the lower quartile, median and upper quartile of sale price divided by the method's base (SDE or annual revenue) unless notes say otherwise. All figures exclude real estate. The engine sends a numeric range only from rows with verified: true.
research_note: Direct page fetches to bizbuysell.com and ibba.org failed in the research session (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, proxy CONNECT 403). BizBuySell rows were verified from search extracts that quote each page's own table (see verified_by). Earlier research (docs/research/offer.md) could not reach any source; docs/research/claims.md found the BizBuySell national median sale price ($349,250, Q2 2026) and the HVAC and landscaping medians.
size_band_syntax: "all", or "sde <min>-<max>" / "price <min>-<max>" in whole dollars, max blank for no ceiling; min inclusive, max exclusive

rows.source: BizBuySell valuation benchmarks: HVAC, businesses sold nationally on BizBuySell
rows.verified_by: 2026-10-18: WebSearch restricted to bizbuysell.com returned an extract of this page quoting its 'Sold Businesses (Sale Price)' earnings-multiple row (lower quartile, median, average, upper quartile). The page itself could not be fetched (DNS failure and proxy 403), so the figures were read from the quoted extract, not the live page. Re-check on the live page each quarter.
rows.notes: Lower quartile, median and upper quartile of sale price / SDE for 562 HVAC sales, 2021-2025; average 2.75. Median sale price $750,000; median SDE $304,309. Revenue multiples (sold): 0.38 / 0.56 / 0.74, average 0.59. Listings ask more (median 2.98x). BizBuySell's all-industry table (sales Q3 2021 to Q2 2026) shows an HVAC average of 2.83x. Private-equity roll-ups pay more above about $1M EBITDA (docs/research/offer.md M8).

rows.source: IBBA and M&A Source Market Pulse, Q2 2026 (median multiple of SDE by sale-price band)
rows.notes: Sale price under $500K: median 2x SDE. Read second-hand only, from Iconic's SDE multiples guide (https://iconic.co/blog/sde-multiples/), which attributes Q2 2026 medians of 2.0x (under $500K), 2.8x ($500K-$1M) and 3.1x ($1M-$2M) to Market Pulse. Duran Advisors gives Q1 2026 as 2.0x, 2.8x and 3.0x. The IBBA PDF was found by search but its text extract held no figures, and ibba.org could not be fetched (DNS failure, proxy 403). Market Pulse publishes one median per band, not a range, so low = mid = high here. Bands are by sale price, not SDE (offer.md verification M11): pickMultiple matches them on the implied price (SDE x mid). Do not send a range from these rows until a person reads the PDF, and add quartiles only from a source that publishes them.
